query: Let `f : P →ᵃ[k] P₂` be an injective affine map, `s` an affine simplex in `P`, and `I ⊆ k` a weight-set defining the "interior" of a simplex. Then the interior of the image simplex `s.map f hf` (with weights in `I`) equals the image under `f` of the interior of `s`: `(s.map f hf).setInterior I = f '' s.setInterior I`.
